summary: rekey_on_member rekeys a list of dicts into a dict keyed by a chosen member.
questions: How do I turn a list of dicts into a dict keyed by one field?

answer_card.title: rekey_on_member filter
answer_card.answer_md: `rekey_on_member` converts a list of dicts into a dict using one member's value as the key, e.g. `rekey_on_member('proto')`.
